summary: More than most people, you swing between a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you draw people in and know what you want; other days you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver. The work is holding both without picking a side.
body: More than most people, you swing between a strong pull toward love, beauty, and what you value and an appetite for more and a need to believe in something, and it often shows up through other people before you own both sides. Some days you draw people in and know what you want; other days you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver. The work is holding both without picking a side. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
gift: At your best: you draw people in and know what you want, and you reach, grow, and lift the room.
shadow: The trap: you smooth things over, or lose yourself in wanting it - or you overreach, overpromise, or talk bigger than you deliver.
integration: Let love and values and growth and belief cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Likable and fortunate; the missing ingredient is discipline.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you draw people in and you reach, grow, work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
